**Finding submitted: RENEWAL — deviation (fallback cure).**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 4.1 (p0024) is the only renewal provision; searches for "renew", price/fee increase, and adjustment language returned no other hits, and Section 3 fees are a fixed 30% revenue share with no uplift mechanic.
- **Analysis:** Automatic successive **one-year** renewals are acceptable (not multi-year, so not walk-away), but the **90-day** non-renewal notice window exceeds the fallback ceiling of 60 days, so the clause fails fallback on a material term.
- **Cure:** One surgical replace — "ninety (90) days written notice" → "sixty (60) days written notice" — leaving the renewal term, Termination Date definition and all surrounding mechanics verbatim. The conditional price-cap element is untriggered (renewal is on the same terms, no uplift right), so no volunteered price language was added.
